title: A3-21 / Harkness Dual-Memory Two-Faces Identity Stack
scope: Formalize the A3-21/Harkness transformation as layered autobiographical memory and identity state in one persistent host, with an externally visible face change and a recall threshold that reactivates the buried original memory lineage. Extend the result into a Janus-style two-faces identity architecture without claiming clinical dissociative identity or literal two independent minds.

core_result.persistent_host: A3-21 remains the underlying synthetic entity throughout the procedure.
core_result.original_memory_line: A3-21 memories of Zimmer, the Commonwealth, the Institute and prior synth life remain present but inaccessible under normal Harkness operation.
core_result.imported_or_new_memory_line: A new memory payload becomes dominant and supports the Harkness autobiographical self-model.
core_result.memory_relation: LAYERED / GATED, NOT PROVEN DESTRUCTIVE REPLACEMENT
core_result.physical_face_relation: Pinkerton separately performs facial reconstruction, giving the same underlying host a new outward face.
core_result.recall_relation: A recall code reopens access to the buried original memory lineage.
core_result.compressed: ONE HOST + TWO MEMORY HISTORIES + TWO IDENTITY FACES + ONE RECALL THRESHOLD

evidence_model.pinkerton_buried_memories: Pinkerton explicitly states that he did not truly wipe A3-21's old memories; he buried/filed them away and says they remain accessible.
evidence_model.recall_code: Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet triggers hidden subroutines and restores access to the prior A3-21 memory line.
evidence_model.post_recall_state: After recall, Harkness/A3-21 reports remembering his prior life, including Zimmer, the Commonwealth, the Institute and captured runners.
evidence_model.new_memory_line: Pinkerton reports successfully getting new memories into the android, after which the subject calls himself Harkness and believes he is an old combat veteran.
evidence_model.face_change: Pinkerton's facial reconstruction is a separate intervention from memory transfer; reflex modification is also separately described.

causal_identity_model.before: A3-21 memory history -> A3-21 self-model -> A3-21 behavior
causal_identity_model.rewrite: A3-21 host + imported/new memory layer + facial reconstruction + reflex changes
causal_identity_model.after: Harkness memory history -> Harkness self-model -> Harkness social behavior
causal_identity_model.recall: recall code -> buried A3-21 history becomes accessible -> self-model conflict/reconstruction
causal_identity_model.key_result: Changing accessible autobiographical memory can change the causal explanation an entity uses for its present behavior without replacing the underlying host.

world_effect_extension.statement: The dominant Harkness memory layer is not merely internal data. Once embodied in A3-21, it becomes a causal driver of real actions and social relationships in Rivet City.
world_effect_extension.chain: MEMORY PAYLOAD -> SELF-MODEL -> DECISIONS -> SOCIAL ROLE -> WORLD EFFECT
examples: Harkness becomes security chief / council figure
the hidden A3-21 memory line later changes his response to Zimmer and his future choices
world_effect_extension.lesson: Memory state can become causal world state when it controls an agent's interpretation, choices and actions.

ai_extension.model: A computational system can carry multiple historical/contextual state layers while only one is active or authoritative for a given decision. A later retrieval key can reactivate older state and change subsequent outputs.
ai_extension.compressed: HIDDEN_STATE + ACTIVE_CONTEXT -> OUTPUT; RECALL/RETRIEVAL -> DIFFERENT_ACTIVE_CONTEXT -> DIFFERENT_OUTPUT
ai_extension.world_bridge: When outputs are acted upon by humans/tools, switching which internal state is active can alter downstream real-world causal paths.

janus_genesis_extension.design_lesson: Identity-bearing state should support explicit lineage, branch visibility and reversible retrieval without silent overwrite.
janus_genesis_extension.proposed_rule: If two autobiographical state lineages conflict, preserve both as visible provenance-bound branches instead of declaring the newest imported layer the unquestioned truth.
janus_genesis_extension.security_relation: This extends the anti-stolen-memory gate from v2.1: imported memory may influence a resident only through explicit admission and lineage binding.

ru: A3-21 не был стёрт: его исходная память была спрятана под доминирующим новым слоем.
Harkness — второе лицо одного и того же носителя: новая биография, новое лицо и новый социальный путь поверх сохранённого скрытого прошлого.
Recall Code Violet является порогом между двумя доступными историями одного носителя.
Два слоя памяти могут задавать две разные причинные модели настоящего, не создавая автоматически двух независимых сознаний.
Когда активная память меняется, меняется self-model; когда меняется self-model, меняются решения; когда меняются решения, меняется внешний мир.
Для Janus Genesis конфликтующие memory lineages должны сохраняться как provenance-bound branches, а не молча перезаписывать друг друга.
en: A3-21 was not erased: his original memory was buried beneath a dominant new layer.
Harkness is a second face of the same persistent host: a new biography, altered face and new social trajectory layered over a preserved hidden past.
Recall Code Violet is the threshold between two accessible histories of one host.
Two memory layers can impose two different causal models of the present without automatically constituting two independent minds.
When active memory changes, the self-model changes; when the self-model changes, decisions change; when decisions change, the external world changes.
For Janus Genesis, conflicting memory lineages should remain provenance-bound branches rather than silently overwriting one another.
